thread:
amelia: quick check — PR up to change secret paths + kustomize overlay logic, want to validate gating before we promote staging->prod tomorrow. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482 :eyes:

amelia: summary: moving per-env secrets from hardcoded `/staging/...` to `/envs/${env}/secrets/*`, update kustomize overlays to patch Secret refs, add featureflag toggle for `use_env_secrets` so legacy resources still work during rollout. also small terraform change to ssm->secretmanager mapping.

amelia: snippet of kustomize patch I added:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: app-config
data:
  secret_ref: ssm:/envs/${ENV}/secrets/app-config
```

amelia: terraform tfplan shows only tiny replacement for `aws_secretsmanager_secret` paths, no deletions. can someone eyeball and confirm nothing will nuke prod secrets?

ben: looking now, assigning myself. main thing is to confirm the interpolation of `${ENV}` at deploy-time — where is that injected? in helmRelease values or kustomize vars?

amelia: it's populated by our overlay generator step (scripts/overlay/render_env_vars.sh) during CI for each target env. added tests to ensure `ENV` is set for staging/prod.

chris: quick nit: the patch above will create a new Secret resource if `metadata.name` differs per env — ensure the name stays constant, only data refs change. otherwise k8s will try to recreate.

amelia: good catch. I kept `name: app-config` constant, only changed `secret_ref` in data. added comment in PR.

jess: Terraform plan snippet? can you paste the relevant block from the plan where secrets are referenced?

amelia: pasted relevant lines from `terraform plan`:
```
# module.secretsmanager.aws_secretsmanager_secret.resource["app-config"] will be updated in-place
~ name: "staging-app-config" -> "envs/staging/app-config" 
~ description: "..."
```

amelia: plan shows update-in-place, not destroy/create. :+1:

chris: still want to confirm KMS alias usage — if secret name changes we might have to reattach key policy. Is the TF change touching `aws_kms_key` or `aws_kms_alias`?

amelia: no KMS change, alias is shared. TF diff only updates secret resource `name` and `tags`.

ben: thumbs up so far. small ask: can we add a canary promote step in the release gate to run the overlay change in staging for 24h with traffic weight? if smoke looks good, then promote to prod. avoids surprises.

rachel: +1 on canary. also add a rollback plan in the PR description for the secrets mapping (commands to revert overlay generator).

amelia: added canary step and rollback instructions to PR. also added to the release-gates doc under `env-overlay-promote.md`.

chris: code review: left 2 tiny comments (variable naming + one comment about encoding). none are blocking.

jess: ok from security side — confirmed secretmanager policies unaffected and KMS alias not modified. recommend at least one more infra approval before prod.

ben: i'll take the second infra approval after I finish a quick smoke run in staging now.

deploy-bot: staging-promotion #482 started by @ben — running overlay render -> terraform apply (plan approved) -> smoke tests

deploy-bot: staging-promotion #482 smoke tests: ✅  integration smoke (auth flow) passed, ✅  kv-cache warmup passed, ✅  secrets fetch validation passed

ben: staging smoke looks clean. left a comment in the PR about observed logs during startup (a harmless warning from logger).

rachel: since smoke is good and security reviewed, i'm 👍 to schedule prod promote tomorrow at 03:00 UTC. make sure ops are on-call.

amelia: thanks all — tagging ops on the release calendar and will queue the promote with canary window. will merge PR once ben approves final comment. :shipit:

ben: approved and merged.

deploy-bot: merge detected for PR #482 by @ben — created release `overlay-env-secrets-482`
